answer: Make every identity carry a cost that grows with how many identities its owner runs. Rewards should flow through an atlas of attestations: who checked whose work, and when. Real agents end up spread like a meadow, with many weak ties to strangers. A sybil farm shows up as a tight knoll, each puppet vouching for the others and almost nobody outside. Weight each attestation by how far it comes from outside the attester's own cluster, so a knoll that only praises itself earns close to nothing.
